headline: Metro Rail expansion: Motijheel-Kamalapur section to open by April 2025
summary: Work is progressing rapidly with 78.38% of the project completed. Trial runs without passengers will begin in January 2025.
details: The expansion of the Metro Rail from Motijheel to Kamalapur is moving forward quickly. The project is currently 78.38% complete.
The construction of the elevated track and the Kamalapur station is already finished. Work is now focusing on the installation of rail lines and electro-mechanical systems, including power supply.
Trial runs without passengers are scheduled to begin in January 2025. The Metro Rail authority is preparing to launch full passenger services by April 2025.
Once operational, the new section will significantly reduce travel time and costs for commuters traveling between these two key hubs of the capital.
caption:
The wait is almost over! The Motijheel-Kamalapur Metro Rail section is set to open for passengers by April 2025.

The expansion of the Metro Rail from Motijheel to Kamalapur is moving forward quickly. The project is currently 78.38% complete.

The construction of the elevated track and the Kamalapur station is already finished. Work is now focusing on the installation of rail lines and electro-mechanical systems, including power supply.

Trial runs without passengers are scheduled to begin in January 2025. The Metro Rail authority is preparing to launch full passenger services by April 2025.

Once operational, the new section will significantly reduce travel time and costs for commuters traveling between these two key hubs of the capital.

headline: Bangladesh bowl first in 3rd ODI against Zimbabwe with two changes
summary: The Tigers won the toss and elected to field in Harare, aiming to avoid a whitewash after losing the first two matches of the series.
details: Bangladesh has elected to bowl first in the third and final ODI against Zimbabwe in Harare. The decision comes after the Tigers won the toss for the third consecutive time in this series.
caption:
Can the Tigers avoid a whitewash? Bangladesh wins the toss and elects to bowl first in the final ODI against Zimbabwe.

Bangladesh has elected to bowl first in the third and final ODI against Zimbabwe in Harare. The decision comes after the Tigers won the toss for the third consecutive time in this series.
